title_en: The Real and Fake Monkey King
page_text_ocr_zh:
仙气环绕的南海落伽山紫竹林里，
沙僧气呼呼地来找观音菩萨。刚进门
就见到孙行者，他举起降魔杖，劈头
盖脸地打过去：“你个泼猴儿！”
page_text_en:
In the fairy-encircled Purple Bamboo Grove of Nansha珞伽 Mountain,
Sha Wujing came angrily to find Guanyin Bodhisattva. As soon as he entered the gate,
he saw Sun Wukong, who raised his demon-subduing staff and swung it down fiercely: “You rascal monkey!”
summary_zh: 沙僧来到南海落伽山紫竹林找观音菩萨，刚进门就见到孙行者，对方举起降魔杖劈头盖脸打来，沙僧怒斥其为泼猴儿。

title_en: The Real and Fake Monkey King
page_text_ocr_zh:
菩萨连忙劝解：“悟净，不可动手，有话好好说。”
沙僧将悟空打晕师父、抢走行李的事儿一一道来，菩萨十分疑惑：“悟空到这里好几天了，从没离开过。”
page_text_en:
The Bodhisattva hurriedly劝解: "Wujing, don't act rashly, let's talk this over calmly." 
Sandy recounted how Wukong had knocked out the Master and stolen the luggage. The Bodhisattva was deeply puzzled: "Wukong has been here for several days and has never left."
summary_zh: 沙僧向观音菩萨控诉孙悟空打晕师父并抢走行李，观音菩萨却表示孙悟空一直留在她这里，对此感到疑惑。

title_en: The Real and Fake Monkey King
page_text_ocr_zh:
沙僧急得脸皱成一团：“我哪儿敢欺瞒您？水帘洞中就有一个孙行者。”
菩萨说：“让悟空和你一起去看看，自然会明白。”
行者与沙僧来到水帘洞外一看，真有个与孙大圣分毫不差的毛脸雷公嘴猴子在饮酒作乐。大圣生气地抡起金箍棒骂道：“你是哪儿来的妖怪？竟敢变成我的样子，占我的地盘！”
page_text_en:
Sha Seng, his face wrinkled with anxiety, said, “How dare I deceive you? There is indeed a Sun Wukong in the Water Curtain Cave.”
Bodhisattva said, “Let Wukong go with you to see for yourselves; you’ll understand soon enough.”
Wukong and Sha Seng arrived at the entrance of the Water Curtain Cave and saw a monkey with a hairy face and a thunderous mouth, identical to Great Sage, drinking and having fun. The Great Sage, furious, swung his golden cudgel and shouted, “Where did you come from, monster? How dare you impersonate me and take over my territory!”
summary_zh: 沙僧向观音菩萨证实水帘洞中确实有孙悟空，菩萨便让孙悟空与沙僧一同前往查看。两人到达后，发现一个与孙悟空一模一样的猴子正在洞外饮酒作乐，孙悟空愤怒地斥责其冒充自己、侵占领地。

title_en: The Real and Fake Monkey King
page_text_ocr_zh:
那猴子也不回答，抡起铁棒迎战。
他们实力相当，不分高下，大战
了三百回合，一直打到南海之上，
惊动了各路神仙。
page_text_en:
The monkey didn't answer and swung his iron rod to fight back.
They were evenly matched, neither gaining the upper hand, and fought for three hundred rounds, all the way to the South Sea, startling the gods from all directions.
summary_zh: 孙悟空与假猴王在南海之上激烈交战三百回合，实力相当，惊动了各路神仙。

title_en: The Real and Fake Monkey King
page_text_ocr_zh:
童子慌忙跑来报告：“菩萨菩萨，真有两个孙悟空打起来了。”
菩萨赶紧出来制止：“先别打了，两边站好，给我看一看。”
page_text_en:
The attendant hurriedly reported: "Bodhisattva, Bodhisattva, there really are two Sun Wukongs fighting!"

The Bodhisattva quickly came out to stop them: "Stop fighting for now, both of you stand still, let me take a look."
summary_zh: 童子向观音菩萨报告有两个孙悟空在打架，菩萨赶来制止并要求双方站好让她查看。

title_en: The Real and Fake Monkey King
page_text_ocr_zh:
他们一个站在这边说：“我是真的！”
一个站在那边吼：“他是假的！”
page_text_en:
One of them stood on this side and said, “I’m the real one!”
One stood on the other side and roared, “He’s the fake!”
summary_zh: 两个外形相同的孙悟空在南海上对峙，一个声称自己是真身，另一个则指认对方是冒牌货，观音菩萨在云端观看着这一幕。

title_en: The Real and Fake Monkey King
page_text_ocr_zh:
菩萨命两名童子各看住一个，等她念紧箍咒，喊疼的那个便是真的。

没想到咒语一响，两个一起喊疼，满地打滚儿直叫唤：“莫念！莫念！”菩萨停下念咒，他们又继续打斗。天兵天将担心误伤真的孙大圣，都不敢动手。菩萨无计可施，便让他们上天宫找玉皇大帝。
page_text_en:
The Bodhisattva ordered two attendants to each hold one of them, and when she chanted the Tightening Headband spell, the one who cried out in pain would be the real one.

Unexpectedly, as soon as the spell was chanted, both cried out in pain, rolling on the ground and shouting, “Stop! Stop!” The Bodhisattva stopped chanting, and they resumed fighting. The heavenly soldiers and generals, fearing they might accidentally harm the real Sun Wukong, dared not intervene. With no other options, the Bodhisattva sent them to the Heavenly Palace to seek the Jade Emperor.
summary_zh: 观音菩萨试图用紧箍咒辨别真假孙悟空，但两人同时喊疼，无法分辨，最终决定让他们上天宫找玉皇大帝裁决。

title_en: The Real and Fake Monkey King
page_text_ocr_zh: 灵霄宝殿上，玉帝得知消息，立即传旨让托塔李天王拿照妖镜来照一照。镜中两个孙悟空竟然丝毫不差、一模一样，玉帝也没办法了。
page_text_en: In the Hall of Supreme Clarity, the Jade Emperor learned of the news and immediately ordered the Heavenly King with the Pagoda to bring the Mirror of Demons to take a look. The two Sun Wukongs in the mirror were exactly the same, identical in every way—there was nothing the Jade Emperor could do.
summary_zh: 玉帝在灵霄宝殿得知两个孙悟空争斗的消息，命托塔李天王用照妖镜辨认，但镜中两人完全相同，玉帝无法分辨真假。

title_en: The Real and Fake Monkey King
page_text_ocr_zh: 他俩又回到唐僧面前，嚷着让师父辨认，唐长老也念起紧箍咒，两人还是一起喊疼，无法认出真假。咒语一停，他们就边打边喊：“保护好师父，我找阎王辨辨去。”
page_text_en: The two of them returned to Master Tang, shouting for him to identify the real one. Master Tang also chanted the Tightening咒, but both cried out in pain at the same time, making it impossible to tell who was genuine. As soon as the incantation stopped, they resumed fighting and shouting, “Protect our master well, I’ll go find King Yan to settle this!”
summary_zh: 两个孙悟空回到唐僧面前，唐僧念紧箍咒也无法分辨真假，两人随即继续打斗，并声称要去找阎王辨明真伪。

title_en: The Real and Fake Monkey King
page_text_ocr_zh: 阎王爷在森罗殿上，吩咐判官拿生死簿来查看。可孙大圣大闹地府时勾掉了自己的名字，阎王爷只得让他俩再到阳间去想想办法。
page_text_en: Yan Wang, in the Hall of Ten Kings, ordered the judge to bring the Book of Life and Death for inspection. But since Sun Wukong had erased his own name when he caused chaos in the underworld, Yan Wang could only tell the two of them to go back to the mortal world and think of another solution.
summary_zh: 两个孙悟空来到地府，阎王爷命判官查生死簿，但因孙悟空曾大闹地府勾销了名字，无法辨别真假，只得让他们回到阳间另想办法。

title_en: The Real and Fake Monkey King
page_text_ocr_zh:
正说着，就听地藏王菩萨道：“且慢！让我的谛听来试试。”
谛听是一头能分辨善恶贤愚的神兽。它仔细听了听，发现假行者神通广大，在幽冥处没法儿捉拿，它悄悄告诉了地藏王菩萨。
page_text_en:
Just as they were speaking, they heard地藏王菩萨 say, "Wait a moment! Let my Diting try." 
Diting is a divine beast capable of distinguishing good from evil, wise from foolish. After listening carefully, it found that the fake pilgrim was immensely powerful and could not be captured in the netherworld. It quietly told 地藏王菩萨.
summary_zh: 地藏王菩萨决定让神兽谛听辨别真假孙悟空，谛听听后发现假行者神通广大，在幽冥处无法捉拿，便悄悄告知了地藏王菩萨。

title_en: The Real and Fake Monkey King
page_text_ocr_zh:
地藏王菩萨就对他们道：“你们两个还是去雷音寺释迦如来那儿分辨吧。”
两人一齐嚷道：“说的是！说的是！找佛祖辨辨去！”
他俩在空中拉拉扯扯，一直斗到西天雷音寺外。
page_text_en:
The Bodhisattva Ksitigarbha said to them, "You two should go to the Western Paradise and ask Buddha Shakyamuni to distinguish the truth." 
Both shouted together, "That's right! That's right! Let's go find the Buddha to sort this out!" 
They tugged and pulled in the air, fighting all the way to the outskirts of the Western Paradise.
summary_zh: 地藏王菩萨建议两个孙悟空去雷音寺找如来佛祖辨明真假，两人随即在空中拉扯着一路打斗到西天雷音寺外。

title_en: The Real and Fake Monkey King
page_text_ocr_zh:
神仙们都在莲台下听如来佛祖讲佛法。大家一看，来了两个行者，佛祖合掌道：“观音，你看看谁真谁假？”
观音菩萨道：“弟子无法辨认，天宫地府也没法儿分辨，这才让他们来这里。”
page_text_en:
The immortals were all listening to Buddha preach the Dharma beneath the lotus throne. When they saw two Sun Wukongs arrive, the Buddha clasped his hands and said, "Guanyin, take a look— which one is real and which is fake?"
Guanyin Bodhisattva replied, "I cannot tell the difference. Neither Heaven nor the Underworld could distinguish them, so I sent them here."
summary_zh: 两个孙悟空打斗至雷音寺外，如来佛祖在莲台下讲法，见状询问观音菩萨如何辨认真假，观音表示天宫地府都无法分辨，故将他们引至此处。

title_en: The Real and Fake Monkey King
summary_zh: 两个孙悟空在雷音寺外激烈打斗，如来佛祖端坐莲台，周围菩萨和弟子们在旁观，观音菩萨在云端注视着这一幕。

title_en: The Real and Fake Monkey King
page_text_ocr_zh: 如来笑道：“你们神通广大，却没能认得天下全部的事物。有四种神猴沉入世间，第一是灵明石猴，第二是赤尻马猴，第三是通臂猿猴，第四是六耳猕猴，假悟空就是这六耳猕猴。”
page_text_en: Buddha smiled and said, "You are mighty in your powers, yet you failed to recognize all things under heaven. There are four kinds of divine monkeys that dwell in the world: the first is the Spirit Stone Monkey, the second is the Red-Buttocked Horse Monkey, the third is the Long-Armed Ape Monkey, and the fourth is the Six-Eared Macaque. The false Wukong is precisely this Six-Eared Macaque."
summary_zh: 如来佛祖在雷音寺外辨认真假孙悟空，指出假悟空是六耳猕猴，并揭示了四种神猴的名称。

title_en: The Real and Fake Monkey King
page_text_ocr_zh:
六耳猕猴听到真实面目被揭穿，
胆战心惊地想逃跑。如来手持金钵
罩住他，再揭起时，孙大圣冲了过来，
抡起金箍棒将他打死。
page_text_en:
The Six-Eared Macaque, upon hearing his true identity revealed, 
felt terrified and tried to flee. Buddha held the golden bowl 
over him; when it was lifted, Sun Wukong rushed forward 
and struck him dead with his golden staff.
summary_zh: 六耳猕猴被如来识破真身后企图逃跑，如来用金钵罩住他，孙悟空随即冲出，用金箍棒将其打死。

title_en: The Real and Fake Monkey King
page_text_ocr_zh:
菩萨送悟空回到
师父身边，说：“唐僧，
之前打你的假行者是六耳
猕猴，还是让悟空继续护
送你上西天取经吧。”
唐僧谢过菩萨，师徒
四人继续西行，灿烂的晚
霞映照着大地。
page_text_en:
The Bodhisattva sent Wukong back to his master's side and said, "Master Tang, the fake pilgrim who attacked you was the Six-Eared Macaque. Let Wukong continue protecting you on your journey to the West to obtain the scriptures." 
Master Tang thanked the Bodhisattva, and the four disciples continued their journey westward, with brilliant evening clouds illuminating the earth.
summary_zh: 菩萨将悟空送回唐僧身边，告知假行者是六耳猕猴，师徒四人继续西行，晚霞映照大地。
